# Python

## Types

### Primitive types

Python primitive types overview.

#### Number

##### integer

```python
a = 42
b = -7
c = int('42')
```

##### float

```python
x = 3.14
y = 1.5e-3
z = float('3.14')
```

##### arithmetic

```python
a + b
a - b
a * b
a / b
```

#### Boolean

##### literal

```python
t = True
f = False
```

##### negation

```python
not True
```

##### logical and

```python
True and False
```

## Collections & Iterators

### Collections

Python collections overview — mutable.

#### List

##### literal

```python
a = [1, 2, 3]
```

##### size

```python
len(a)
```

##### lookup

```python
a[0]
a[-1]
```

#### Dictionary

##### literal

```python
d = {'t': 1, 'f': 0}
```

##### size

```python
len(d)
```

##### lookup

```python
d['t']
```

#### Set

##### literal

```python
s = {1, 2, 3}
```

##### size

```python
len(s)
```

##### add

```python
s.add(4)
```
